info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Gap Analysis Insights API
info.description: The Gap Analysis Insights API provides detailed insights into the differences between current banking models and desired outcomes. This endpoint allows users to retrieve analysis results for specific parameters, aiding in strategic decision-making and resource allocation. Financial analysts and business strategists can use this information to identify performance gaps and prioritize improvements. By leveraging these insights, organizations can enhance operational efficiency and better align their banking services with customer expectations.

get.summary: Retrieve gap analysis details by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the detailed gap analysis associated with a specific resource ID. Use this operation to gain insights into the analysis results and related data for informed decision-making.

requestBody.description: A request to retrieve the gap analysis data for the specified model. This request body must include all necessary parameters as defined in the schema.

200.description: The request was successful, and the response contains the requested data.

GetGapAnalysisByIdRequest.description: This schema defines the structure for the operation gap analysis request body in JSON format.

GetGapAnalysisByIdResponse_200.title: Gap Analysis Response

portfolioId.description: Identifier for the portfolio associated with the model.

asOfDate.description: The date as of which the analysis is relevant.

scenario.description: The scenario under which the analysis is performed.

confidenceLevel.description: Confidence level of the analysis, expressed as a number.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the response was last updated.

GetGapAnalysisByIdResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response structure for gap analysis.

GapAnalysisMetadata.title: Gap Analysis Metadata

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the response was processed.

GapAnalysisMetadata.description: Metadata information related to the gap analysis response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint being accessed. This helps in tracking and monitoring API usage.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that is executing the request, which can be useful for debugging and logging purposes.
